notes.title: ⚓ Sailing Toward 1.0 – Permanent Price Drop to $5.99
notes.content:
[h2]The sea is restless, and so are we: 
[i]Dreadline: Net Quota[/i] is steering toward 1.0 launch![/h2][p]As part of that journey, we’re making a permanent price drop. From now on, the game will be just $5.99 no hooks, no bait-and-switch.[/p][p]To everyone who already bought the game. Thank you. Your early support kept this leaky boat afloat, and we’re working on a way to properly compensate you. You’ll hear more on that soon.[/p][p]When 1.0 arrives, expect more than just patched planks. We’re adding fresh content, polish, and a few surprises lurking beneath the waves. Bigger catches, nastier seas, and hats so fancy they might just distract you from certain doom.[/p][p]Grab your friends, brace for the darkness, and get ready: the haul ahead is going to be our biggest yet.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/91568dfba3f42041dea4632330992b7184692def.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Sincerly [/p][p]The Mana Brigade Dev Team
[/p]

notes.title: 🎃Ghastly Stream + 20% Off 🎣
notes.content:
[p]Welcome aboard, fish freaks and horror heads! This weekend we’re setting sail straight into the fog to celebrate the [i]Ghastly Update[/i] [b]and[/b] a [b]20% discount[/b] on the game.[/p][p]👻 [b]Meet the Sea Ghast[/b] – A spectral menace haunting the Ship Graveyard. Run, swim, or… get dragged under.
✋ [b]New First-Person Animations[/b] – Panic in style as you fish, repair, and flail.
📰 [b]Interactive Newspaper[/b] – Catch up on the spooky local headlines.
🐟 [b]Fish Rarity Display[/b] – Find out if your catch is rare… or cursed.
🎭 [b]Emote Camera[/b] – Dramatic zooms for maximum flair.[/p][p]We’ll be exploring new islands, testing Steam Deck support, and probably screaming into the new Death Chat.[/p][p]Come for the chaos, stay for the hats… and grab the game [b]20% off[/b] while you can![/p][p]Grab your latern, watch your back, and join the voyage… if you dare. 🌊💀[/p]

notes.title: Shark Week Special - Nom Nom Nom!! 🦈

Whether you're here to dodge monsters or just wear silly hats, this one’s for you.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]🦑 New & Festive Content[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]🦈 Shark Hat Cosmetic[/b] A fin-tastic Issue[/b] Fixed player movement freezing when right-clicking to exit the wardrobe.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Only Host Could Animate Wardrobe[/b] Now synced across clients.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Signs Clipping parts now hum like they should.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rubber Duck Fix[/b] Reattached the duck’s audio and harbor position.[/p][/*][*][p][b]VOIP Echo[/b] Reduced spooky feedback from the void. - No more notes.title: ⚓Patch Notes - 250624⚓
notes.content:
[h3]🎙️ [b]Hey hey, haunted anglers![/b][/h3][p]We’ve been untangling more bugs and cleaning the deck after the last few chaotic voyages. This patch is a smaller one, but it's all about quality-of-life and weird fish behavior — the [i]wiggling has been stopped[/i], the [i]wardrobe now makes satisfying sounds[/i], and the [i]lobby won't instantly betray you[/i].
We're listening, tweaking, and slowly making the seas a little smoother (and louder).[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 [b]What’s New[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🐟 [b]Fish no longer jitter and spasm[/b] on the boat
Turns out frozen fish don’t flop.[/p][/*][*][p]❄️ [b]Inventory fish now freeze in place[/b]
They stay right where you left them — no more accidental cannonballing.[/p][/*][*][p]💀 [b]Lobby no longer kills the entire crew[/b] when one player leaves
Who knew the lobby wasn’t supposed to be the final boss?[/p][/*][*][p]🔊 [b]Base VOIP volume increased[/b]
You can now hear your crewmates panic [i]a little more clearly[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]🧭 [b]Codfather “heads up” ping[/b]
A radar ping now plays when he's locked on to your scent — RUN.[/p][/*][*][p]🛍️ [b]UI sounds added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Missing hover sounds filled in[/p][/*][*][p]Wardrobe now opens and closes with actual [i]sound[/i]. Satisfying.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌊 [b]Thanks for sailing with us[/b][/h3][p]We’re keeping the chaos alive, but hopefully a little less fish-floppy. Your bug reports, screams, and cursed screenshots help us keep making Dreadline better — one haunted harpoon at a time.[/p][p]See you out there, and remember: frozen fish don’t scream.[/p]

notes.title: ⚓Patch Notes - 250619⚓
notes.content:
[p][b]Ahoy again, dredgers of the deep![/b][/p][p]We've been swimming through your feedback and squashing some of the slipperiest bugs yet. From phantom boats clipping through islands to mysterious shop upgrades with zero explanation — this patch should smooth out some of the roughest waters.[/p][p]Thanks to everyone who's been testing, breaking, and occasionally screaming their way through Dreadline — you're helping us reel in the chaos, one patch at a time.[/p][p][/p][h2]🛥️ [b]Boat & World Interaction[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]No more sailing through solid matter![/b] The boat will now properly collide with islands. ([i]Turns out, player boat shouldn’t be ghost ships.[/i])[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🕰️ [b]UI & Visual Updates[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Clock visual overhaul[/b]
Both the HUD and the ship’s in-game clock got a clarity pass.
Time to actually know what time it is.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shop hover-over text added[/b]
Now you can see what upgrades do [i]before[/i] buying them.
Imagine that![/p][/*][*][p][b]Float rods moved slightly[/b]
We nudged them to the right — should make clicking the correct rod way easier.
([i]Muscle memory: updated.[/i])[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐛 [b]Crash Reporting Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Crash reports now auto-send (with permission)[/b]
This helps us track down and squash more bugs moving forward.
Thanks for suffering for science![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]We're still hunting a few deep-sea bugs (and yes, some fish still think they're birds), but your reports are helping us patch faster than ever.[/p][p]Keep sharing what you find, Wishlist the game if you haven’t already, and as always — join the Discord to help out shape the games future! We're counting on you! 💖

Now get back out there and catch something weird. 🎣[/p]

notes.title: Day one Patch
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p]We’ve been going through your feedback from day one — thank you so much for playing and sharing your thoughts![/p][p]This patch includes some early tweaks to help fine-tune that [i]dreadful[/i] feeling we’re aiming for.
We really appreciate all the reviews, bug reports, and chaos — it’s helping us shape this game into something special.[/p][p]Thanks for being part of the journey 💙[/p][p][/p][h2]🦈 [b]Codfather Adjustments[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Codfather aggression rebalanced[/b][/p][list][*][p]Aggro builds up 76%[b] slower[/b] than before.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aggro decays 3x faster[/b] by before, making it easier to shake him off... at first.[/p][/*][*][p]Speed needed to trigger aggro lowered by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]But beware — over your first 10 days, his temper increases...[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Spawning behavior improved[/b][/p][list][*][p]Codfather will [b]no longer appear directly in front of the boat[/b] — giving you a fair chance to escape.[/p][/*][*][p]He now [b]spawns 75% farther away[/b], From 200 → 350 units for more breathing room.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Minimap improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Codfather now appears on the minimap[/b] when aggroed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Movement behavior updated[/b][/p][list][*][p]Codfather moves [b]25% slower when close to the boat[/b], giving tight escapes a better shot.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🛥️ [b]Boat Handling & Performance[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Base speed increased by 37.5%[/b][/p][list][*][p]From 8 → 11. Zoom zoom.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Steering responsiveness increased by 50%[/b][/p][list][*][p]From 10 → 15. Smoother turns, better panic slides.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Client handling now properly synced[/b][/p][list][*][p]Steering and speed should feel consistent across host and clients. No more sluggish turns for passengers![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🗺️ [b]Navigation & Radar[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Main island now visible on the minimap[/b][/p][list][*][p]Makes it easier to orient yourself and your crewmates when returning from the fog.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐛 [b]Known Issues[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Fish physics are still slippery.[/b]
Caught fish may [b]launch, slide, or clip through the boat[/b] like they’ve got unfinished business. We're wrangling it![/p][/*][*][p][b]Stability issues on respawn.[/b]
Some players experience [b]occasional crashes or flow-breaking glitches[/b], especially during respawn or transitions.[/p][/*][/list][p]We're actively working on these! If you encounter any crashes, please send us your Player.log — it really helps us track these down. 

Location of the player log is at C:\\Users\\USER\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Mana Brigade\\DreadLine\\Player.log ![/p]

notes.title: Dreadline: Net Quota is OUT NOW!
notes.content: [h1]Hey Crewmates![/h1][p][b]The engine's smoking, the fish are cursed, and you're deep in debt — [i]Dreadline: Net Quota[/i] is officially LIVE in Early Access on Steam![/b][/p][p]Grab your 2–6 player crew and plunge into co-op chaos, where every run is a mess of sea monsters, engine breakdowns, and arguments over fuel (and hats).[/p][p]We didn’t manage to fit [i]everything[/i] we wanted into the game for Early Access—there’s still more we’re dying to add. As a bit of a “sorry” (and a thank-you), we’re launching with a [/p][h2][b]Launch Discount: 40% off for two weeks![/b][/h2][p]This is just the start. We’re going to keep building, patching, and adding the weird stuff we couldn’t squeeze in yet—and your feedback on Discord is going to help shape all of it.[/p][p]So if you want to help steer this chaotic ship (or at least keep it afloat), now’s the time to jump in.[/p][p][/p][h3]❗ [b]Note:[/b] We’ve temporarily taken down the demo to focus on improving the full game. Thanks for your patience and understanding![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/cd9e0334e848ad434b1d99a7715093f7c5e27f5d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🚢 Roadmap: What’s Coming Next?[/h2][p]We’re building [i]Dreadline[/i] with the community at the helm — and here’s what’s on the horizon:[/p][h3]📍 [b]New Biomes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Coral Reef[/p][/*][*][p]Tree-Infested Waters[/p][/*][*][p]Rocky Ocean[/p][/*][/list][h3]👹 [b]Upcoming Monsters[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Angry Seagull[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Sea Ghast[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Cthulhu?!?[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Necksnapper Fish[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Vengeful Walrus[/b][/p][/*][*][p]…and more 👀[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎯 [b]Side Quests[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Catch specific fish for NPCs to unlock bizarre fishy rewards.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎣 [b]New Fishing Rod Types[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Spearfishing[/p][/*][*][p]Netfishing[/p][/*][*][p]Magnetfishing[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamite fishing?![/p][/*][/list][h3]🚢 [b]More Coming[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New boat mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]New fish species[/p][/*][*][p]More events, disasters, and glorious hats[/p][/*][/list][h2]Here’s a teaser featuring two monsters. 👹[/h2][h3]Angry Seagull aka. Steven[/h3][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/5df8af71753caed82f676ceacfa974870f7a630c.gif"][/img][/h2][h3][b]Sea Ghast[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/e38023f1f3ade433fed410cbf2ddb61a693131b1.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.content:
[h2]Hey fishers, survivors, and brave boaters![/h2]

[i]We’ve been hard at work gutting bugs, refining systems, and stuffing the seas with new features. This update is one of our biggest yet, and it's packed with a TON of content for you to explore and test out.[/i]

[b]🌟 What’s New[/b]
[list]
[*] New HUD for a cleaner, more intuitive experience

[*] Biome-specific ambiance improvements
[*] Radio in the cabin – go twist the dial
[*] Story-rich island updates
[*] Lighthouse harbors – sell, sleep, and respawn in new places
[*] Global and local maps now available
[*] Danger scaling across the map with new generation tech
[*] Boat sway synced across all players
[*] Boat now stops correctly when engine shuts off
[*] Audio warnings before engine failure
[*] Engine won’t break while idle
[*] Codfather now breaks your boat (he’s hangry)
[*] Improved boat physics and unsticking
[*] Full character customization – hats, bodies, titles!
[*] Going too far from the boat? You’ll die now.

[*] Save your drowning friends with the Life Buoy

[b]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Main menu buttons fixed

[*] Maps easier to use

That’s everything for this update! We’re super excited for you to try it all out. Your feedback continues to shape the game, and we can’t thank you enough for being part of the journey. Now get out there, catch some fish, and maybe dodge a tentacle or two. 🐙🎣

Stay safe on the seas,
Mana Brigade

notes.title: FINAL PLAYTEST UPDATE: PATCHES, PERILS, AND A QUESTION ABOUT BLOOD
notes.content:
The end is near… of the [i]playtests[/i], that is.

Mr. S.Hark’s ledger is thicker than ever, and you’ve all done your part  hauling in monsters, breaking our code (and boats), and giving us feedback that’s reshaped the entire game.

This patch is a [b]love letter[/b], if love letters came covered in fish guts and tentacle bruises. A lot of what’s below? That’s because you asked for it. Some of it? You didn’t. We did it anyway.

[b]🧪 FINAL PLAYTEST RUNS MAY 23–25[/b]
 This is it — the last time to set sail before the storm hits. Bring friends. Bring questions. Bring bait.

[h2]And one thing before you go 🩸[/h2]
Should we add blood and gore to the game? More guts, more impact, more mess — or is it better when the horror stays a little... damp and implied?
We want to hear from you. Drop your thoughts on Discord or in the Steam forums!

[h2]🐟 COMMUNITY-DRIVEN FIXES & ADDITIONS[/h2]

[b]🎩 CUSTOMIZATION UNLOCKED[/b]
Bodies, hats, and titles are in. You finally get to look like the fisherman of your nightmares.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/5643a1334f3fa169ff7b029446356fae3f65baf5.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/5643a1334f3fa169ff7b029446356fae3f65baf5.gif[/img][/url]

[b]🛟 DROWNING IS A FEATURE NOW[/b]
 You can drown. Your friends can save you. Or not. Teamwork!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/2ce7d59d6210ee452024ae08156817301b7e3c01.gif[/img]

[b]🐠 FISH MATTER NOW[/b]
 They’ve got rarities, personalities, values. No more four-eyed ghostfish. Also: the goofy ones stayed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/d55fd4145b48bd7ca995b14d0526fd55464d6bee.png[/img]

[b] 🎨 NEW LOOK: CELL SHADING & CREEPY-CUTE VIBES
We’ve updated the art direction with cell shading — sharper silhouettes, bolder shapes, and more character across the board.
Monsters are scarier, fish are cuter, and your crewmates still look like they haven’t slept in days. Perfect.

[b]🧭 MAPS, LIGHTHOUSES, SAFE ZONES[/b]
 New maps at every lighthouse and harbor. You can now respawn, sell, and sleep far from home  if you make it that far.

[b]🚪 No More Quadruple Wishlist Portals[/b]
 Main menu buttons now behave like buttons. One click. One result. Magic.

[b]📺 ONBOATING, In-Boat TVs, and Not Dying Immediately[/b]
 You asked for a gentler start. We added TVs, tutorials, and a few signs so your first hour isn’t your last.

[b]🎣 FISHING GOT CLARITY[/b]
 "Catch" is now "Float." "Throw" is now "Cast." And we updated the mechanics. Still figuring it out. Still hard.

[b]🚢 ENGINE & BOAT LOGIC[/b]
 The boat doesn’t drive away when you die. The engine doesn't explode during coffee breaks. And it gives you a warning before going kaput. Progress.

[b]🦑 TENTACLES ARE REAL & THEY SLAP[/b]
 They’re visible. They’re synced. They slap, but don’t insta-kill. Growth!

[b]🧠 YOU LOOK PEOPLE IN THE EYES NOW[/b]
 Characters track players. Mouths move when you scream. We added just enough uncanny valley to keep things spicy.

[b]📻 NEW RADIO, NEW VIBES[/b]
 There’s a radio now. It does… something. We’re not telling. Go fiddle with it.

[b]🪓 WHAT WE CUT (FOR NOW)[/b]
We "killed some darlings" to focus the chaos:
[list]
[*] Spearfishing 🪛
[*] Steven Seagull 🕊
[/list]
They might return. Maybe worse. Maybe better. Probably worse.

[b]❤️ THANK YOU, PLAYTESTERS[/b]
This upcoming patch is because of you. We’re grateful, we’re exhausted, and we’re still wildly behind on fish puns.
Join us the 23-25 of May :) 
[list]
[*] What you loved
[*] What you hated
[*] And if it’s time to add some blood to the brine
[/list]
See you in the harbor. Just… don’t stay past nightfall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549285/7a5e6670267a8bcbe6fe00dd38d0bed63a2fedd1.jpg[/img]
— Mana Brigade

notes.title: Devlog April
notes.content:
Dreadline Devlog #1 – Playtest Recap & What’s Next

[previewyoutube=fU17owz7hsI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]Hey everyone! 👋[/h1]

[i]Welcome to our very first devlog for Dreadline. We recently wrapped up a playtest, and we wanted to take a moment to break down what we learned, the feedback we received, and where we’re heading next.[/i]
[h3]🎣 First off, thank you![/h3]
A huge shoutout to everyone who jumped in and helped us test the game. Seeing players explore the world we've built (and get spooked by our big fish monster) was incredible. Your feedback is already helping shape the future of Dreadline.
[h3]🐟 What’s Working[/h3]
[list]
[*] The fishing gameplay and minigame mechanics got a big thumbs up—awesome news since that’s the heart of the game.
[*] The big monster encounters hit the mark (yes, it’s supposed to be that scary).
[*] The atmosphere? Chef’s kiss. Players really felt the tension and unease we were aiming for.
[/list]
[h3]⚙️ Quality of Life Fixes Incoming[/h3]
We’ve got some quick wins and planned tweaks on the way:
[list]
[*] A proper settings menu (including mouse sensitivity)
[*] VOIP controls yes, you’ll be able to mute it
[*] Motion sickness fixes we hear you and are working on smoothing things out
[*] Private lobbies 100% yes, coming soon
[*] Crouching and emotes on the wishlist, with emotes coming in a future sprint
[/list]
[h3]🚢 Boat Life Updates[/h3]
We’re expanding what life on your vessel looks like:
[list]
[*] More tools, creatures, and events on the boat
[*] Additional boat upgrades and eventual customization
[*] Better collision detection and improved boat physics
[*] Lures? Still debating. TBD!
[/list]
[h3]👹 Monsters & Mechanics[/h3]
Our deep-sea horrors are getting refined:
[list]
[*] More dramatic monster appearances with better telegraphing
[*] Diverse counterplay some monsters need brains, not brawn
[*] No more getting attacked while docked (oops!)
[*] Lifebuoys, spotlight mechanics, and yes more radio chatter
[/list]
[h3]📈 Game Progression & Balance[/h3]
We're dialing in the game's core loop:
[list]
[*] More fish types are on the way
[*] Quota system is evolving think somewhere between Lethal Company and Content Warning
[*] Showing fish value is under review we’re toying with keeping parts of the economy mysterious
[*] A day/night cycle is coming, and with it, new threats and flexible selling times
[*] Jump height = being fixed (no more low-orbit fishing)
[*] Engine breakdowns will tie into new boat interaction systems like a fusebox
[/list]
[h3]💬 Final Thoughts[/h3]
[i]Just a reminder—this was a playtest, not a demo. We’re still in active development, and these sessions are key to making Dreadline the best it can be. If you played, we’d love to hear more from you. Your feedback is shaping the experience in real time.
[/i]
Thanks again for joining us. Until next time, stay safe out on the water…

🧜‍♂️ You never know what’s lurking beneath.

💬 Like and follow for more updates. We’ll [b]sea [/b]you next time... if you make it back to shore.

☀️Please help us spread the word about our game and join our [url=https://discord.gg/fNxqDr6yha]Discord [/url]if you want to be a part of shaping the future of our game.
